speaker: Penny
text: Hey, Howard. Howard, why don't we just work on the robot?

speaker: Howard
text: Unstoppable, anything but a compliment. Oh, please, Leonard, not now. Once again, Penny and I have begun our little tango.

speaker: Howard
text: The carnal repartee, the erotic to and fro, but as delicious as the appetizer might be, at some point we will have to succumb and eat the entree while it's still...

speaker: Howard
text: Hot. I'm begging you, stop talking.

speaker: Penny
text: Look, normally I can just ignore you. I mean, I get it, you're a little peculiar, you know, like Sheldon.

speaker: Howard
text: Excuse me, Penny, but in this room, you're the one who's peculiar.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, you might be right. But back to you. I know you think you're some sort of smooth-talking ladies' man, but the truth is you are just pathetic and creepy.

speaker: Howard
text: Um, so what are you saying?

speaker: Penny
text: I am saying it is not a compliment to call me doable. It is not sexy to stare at my ass and say, ooh, it must be jelly 'cause jam don't shake like that.

speaker: Penny
text: And most important, we are not dancing a tango. We're not, we're not toing and froing. Nothing is ever gonna happen between us, ever.

speaker: Howard
text: Wait a minute, this isn't flirting. You're serious.

speaker: Penny
text: Flirting? You think I'm flirting with you? I am not flirting with you! No woman is ever gonna flirt with you. You're just gonna grow old and die alone.

speaker: Howard
text: Thanks for the heads up. Howard, where are you going? I'm going home to live my creepy, pathetic life. Wow.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, someone had to say it.
